title: SEAT BACK LOCK ASSEMBLY
summary: Bucket seat back lock (the seat back latch that keeps the seat back from folding forward, released by the button at the top of the seat back). The lock is a long vertical bar on the back of the seat back: its lower end is screwed to the seat cushion frame (with a shim under it), its upper end is screwed to the upper seat back with screws and nuts; the release button is screwed to the top of the lock. A bolt with washer and a weld nut at the lower seat back is also shown. A shipping screw in the release tab must be removed after installation.

parts.name: SHIM
parts.name_expanded: Shim – under seat back lock lower bracket

fastening.note: Main view: the lower bracket of lock [1] sits on shim [8] (with a SPACER under it for shipping, see UPC 0 misc. shipping list); screw [4] goes down through the bracket and shim into the cushion. Step 1 of the instructions.

Main view: at the top of the lock [1], screws [3] go in from the back through the seat back and the lock, and nut assemblies [2] (torque 1, 35-50 LBS IN) go on the other side. Done after rotating the seat back rearward against the cushion bumpers (instructions steps 2-3).
Main view: a second screw [3] goes through the lock [1] lower pivot area into the lower seat back frame from the back.
View A: screw assembly [5] goes through the top plate of the lock [1] into the release button [6]. A SHIPPING SCREW in the release tab area lower on the lock is removed after installation (step 4).

fastening.to: lower seat back, outboard of the lock (near the WELD NUT)
fastening.note: Main view: bolt assembly [7] is drawn vertical with washer [9] beneath it at the lower seat back by the hinge; a WELD NUT is called out on the cushion/seat back joint next to it. Exactly what it clamps is not clear.

notes: Mandatory installation instructions: 1) Install lock [1] at the lower seat cushion with screw [4]. 2) Rotate the seat back rearward until it rests against the bumpers on the cushion. 3) Attach [1] at the upper seat back with screws [3] and nuts [2]. 4) Remove the shipping screw from the release tab area of [1].
